The so-called '''Lost Prophet''' was originally a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]]. Toward the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], that trooper crash-landed on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Du Mai]] while piloting an [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. Because of the crash, he sustained head injuries that caused him to utter snippets of his initial conditioning and [[flash training]] in the [[Kamino cloning chamber|hatcheries]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], where the clones were created. He took refuge in a Du Mai [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] cave, and some visitors started to take his displays of mental agitation for psychic powers, which earned him the name of Lost Prophet. Pilgrims started to visit him on Du Mai, asking for advice, while he would repeat incoherent bits of his military programming. In [[21 ABY/Legends|21 ABY]], the [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Cindel Towani]] ended up discovering the true nature of the Du Mai seer as a [[Brain/Legends|brain]]-addled clone from the Clone Wars era.<ref name="Blog" />
